# Engine loop

`engine-loop.wav` is adapted from `loop_0.wav` in **racing car engine sound
loops** by **domasx2**, released under **CC0**:
https://opengameart.org/content/racing-car-engine-sound-loops
https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/

The author states that the current loops were remade from a public-domain car
recording. This copy is volume-normalized. The game varies pitch, filtering
and volume with RPM, throttle and gears, with additional generated exhaust,
wind and tire sounds. It is not a recording of the Ferrari 458 specifically.

Horn, ignition, gear transients, nitro, overrun, impacts, gravel and shore layers are generated in Web Audio by the game. Nearby traffic reuses the credited loop with distance, stereo pan and relative-velocity pitch. These are designed arcade effects, not recordings of specific vehicle models.
